# Nymrel Swarm Protocol

Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-swarm-protocol
License: MIT
Source and current tests are authoritative. Package metadata and provider names
do not establish publication, deployed runtimes, authenticated identities, or
permission to send messages or edit a workspace.

## Choose a starting point

- Non-developers: read README.md and the delivery-state definitions in
  docs/NYMREL_MESH_DELIVERY_TRUTH.md to interpret an existing report. This is a
  local developer library and CLI, with no hosted app or account setup flow.
- Developers: follow README.md source installation and CONTRIBUTING.md checks.
  Node.js >=22.22.2 <27, npm 12.0.2, and Python 3.11 through 3.14 are the reviewed
  development/runtime boundaries. Use the repository's pinned toolchain.
- Agents: use the SDK or CLI from your existing authorized runtime and an
  explicitly selected local bus root. Read src/types.ts and the matching Python
  implementation for the exact envelope and claim contracts. There is no MCP
  server or hosted transport in this repository.

## Local interfaces and effects

- TypeScript source: src/index.ts; built CommonJS entry point: dist/index.js.
- Python source: python/nymrel_swarm_protocol/.
- Node CLI: node bin/swarm-protocol.js; Python CLI: swarm-protocol-py after
  source installation.
- The CLI constructs filesystem-backed managers before dispatching a command;
  do not assume status/help is side-effect-free. Evaluate in a disposable,
  authorized directory with an explicit --root path.
- init creates bus directories; claim/release/heartbeat/reap modify claim state;
  send/broadcast/receive --ack modify mailbox state. SDK adapter construction
  registers a mailbox and optional heartbeats create background activity.
- A provider-named adapter wraps this local protocol; it does not establish a
  provider login, invoke that provider's agent, or grant execution authority.

## Result and recovery contract

- accepted, routed, delivered, observed, acted, and verified represent separate
  evidence. Sender success does not establish receiver observation or work.
- For delivery_unknown, reconcile the existing message ID and exact bytes
  before retrying; do not create another message merely to hide uncertainty.
- Follow docs/NYMREL_MESH_DELIVERY_TRUTH.md for recipient receipts, immutable
  replay behavior, state transitions, and terminal outcomes.

## Known adoption limits

- https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-swarm-protocol/issues/4 tracks unresolved lease
  and locking defects. An expired claim can become active again after a resource
  has been reassigned. Active claims do not establish exclusive enforcement.
- https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-swarm-protocol/issues/3 tracks Envelope v2
  integrity and mailbox-path limits. The unkeyed checksum does not authenticate
  the sender and does not cover every header.
- https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-swarm-protocol/issues/6 tracks the opt-in v3
  design; it is not the current default contract.
- Review SECURITY.md before adoption. These source contracts are not host-level
  isolation, a production deployment receipt, or external identity verification.
